g.text: (a date, not a timestamp — these get logged
the next morning and the hour is not information)
(a note to yourself about the week — never charted)
(free text, not an FK — "her birthday" is useful
long before the occasion row exists)
(so the list can put two-minute options first)
is computed, never retyped each year)
(an idea that surfaces the day before is no use)
(what you would do differently — a reading list
without this is a list of things you can say you read)
This exists to reassure, not to score.
There is deliberately no target column, no streak
counter and no rating of the relationship anywhere
in these four tables. Recording that something
happened is so you can check, on a bad evening,
that it happened recently — and a schema that could
express "you are 2 under this week" would eventually
be made to say so on screen.
Nothing is seeded: this is the most personal data in
the app and the repo is public.
a moment and closes the loop
